title: Handover at the End of a Night Shift
title_ar: تسليم شغل في آخر وردية ليل
gist_ar: تسليم فني بسرعة وبمصطلحات مغلقة. المطلوب: التفاصيل الرقمية بالظبط.

before_listening.en: A night engineer handing over, fast, in his own shorthand. Nothing is explained twice.
before_listening.ar: مهندس ورديّة الليل بيسلّم بسرعة وبمختصراته. مفيش حاجة تتشرح مرتين.

segments.speaker: Yousef (night)
segments.text: Right, I'll do this once because I want my bed. Pumps: three and four are fine, don't touch them. Two is the one. Two has been cavitating on and off since about half one, and it's not the impeller because I pulled the inspection plate and it's clean. My money is on the suction side — I think we're drawing air past the gland, and the reason I think that is the noise changes when the header tank drops below about a third. So: keep that tank above a third and it behaves. It's a bodge, not a fix. Day shift can have the fix.

segments.speaker: Rania (day)
segments.text: Above a third. And if it goes below?

segments.speaker: Yousef (night)
segments.text: Then it'll start hammering, you'll hear it from the door, and you drop it to manual and bring it down over about ninety seconds. Don't trip it. If you trip it you'll take the line with it, because the interlock on two is still wired to the old logic — that's job number four-oh-nine, it's been open since February, and no, nobody is doing it this week either. Second thing. The chiller. Ignore the alarm on the panel, the alarm is the sensor and not the chiller. Actual outlet temp is reading seven-point-two on the local gauge and the panel is telling you eleven. The gauge is right. I put a bit of tape on it with 'GAUGE IS RIGHT' on it so nobody panics at ten in the morning.

segments.speaker: Rania (day)
segments.text: Panel eleven, gauge seven-two, believe the gauge. Have you logged that?

segments.speaker: Yousef (night)
segments.text: Logged it, and I've raised it as a sensor swap, but it's low priority so it'll sit. Third thing, and this is the one I'd actually worry about. Somebody has changed a setpoint on line two overnight and it wasn't me. Fill weight was two hundred and fifty grams at ten last night and it is two hundred and forty-six now. Four grams. Nobody has logged it, there's no initials against it, and four grams across a night is roughly — I did the sum at four in the morning so check me — about eleven kilos of product we have not put in a pot.

segments.speaker: Rania (day)
segments.text: You're saying it drifted or you're saying somebody set it?

segments.speaker: Yousef (night)
segments.text: I'm saying I don't know, and that's exactly why I'm telling you rather than just putting it back. If I put it back the evidence goes with it. So it's still sitting at two-four-six, the line is still running, and I've written the time I found it — three-fifty — on the sheet. If it drifted, we have a controller problem. If somebody set it, we have a different problem entirely, and I'd rather the person who has to answer for it isn't whichever of us happens to be standing here.

segments.speaker: Rania (day)
segments.text: No, that's right. Leave it. I'll get Nadia down before I change anything.

segments.speaker: Yousef (night)
segments.text: Good. So: tank above a third, gauge over panel, don't touch two-four-six. Everything else is boring. Sign here and I'm gone.

gist_question.q: Why has Yousef deliberately left the fill weight at 246 grams?
options: Because 246 grams is the correct specification
Because changing it back would destroy the evidence of who or what altered it
Because the controller cannot be adjusted during a running shift
Because Nadia had already approved the new figure

questions.q: What must be done to keep pump two behaving?
options: Keep the header tank above a third full
Replace the impeller before the line restarts
Run it in manual for the whole shift
Keep the header tank below a third

questions.q: Which temperature reading does Yousef say is correct?
options: The local gauge reading of seven-point-two
The panel reading of eleven
Neither, both need recalibration
The panel, once the sensor is swapped

questions.q: What will happen if pump two is tripped rather than brought down manually?
options: The chiller alarm will reset itself
The gland will need replacing immediately
It will take the line down, because the interlock is still on the old logic
The fill weight will drift further

questions.q: How much product does Yousef estimate the four-gram difference represents?
options: About four kilos
About eleven kilos across the night
About two hundred and forty-six kilos
About ninety kilos
